facts.fact: Creadev (a French private equity firm) and Juven provided Twiga Foods, a Nairobi-based produce platform, a US$35 million convertible debt round in December 2023, used to clear overdue supplier debts, per TechCabal.
Twiga Foods said it committed approximately US$10 million in May 2022 to launch Twiga Fresh, a commercial farming subsidiary in Kenya (1,606 acres in Taita Taveta), per TechCabal.

note: The US$185.4m total raised from Goldman Sachs, IFC and Creadev is an undated aggregate over many rounds, not one deal, so no fact is taken from it.
